meta.description: 테스트/검증이 필요할 때 사용한다. 'qa', '검증해', '테스트 돌려', 'test-fix', '심층 검증', '철저히 테스트', '보안까지 확인', '전방위 검증' 같은 요청에 반드시 사용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行测试并做深度质量验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在发布前彻底验证功能是否正确
copy.tagline_en: Run tests and deep verification for quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to thoroughly verify features before release

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求做测试或验证时，Claude 会运行测试，并用多个 AI 检查器从功能、安全、用户体验三方面独立检查，汇总问题后自动修复，最后给出带通过/失败和修复摘要的 QA 报告。
howto.when: 当你说“qa”、“验证”等关键词，或要求运行测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我深度验证一下项目。
say.note: 触发Deep模式，三路检查后给报告。

say.text: 检查 src/auth 的改动有没有问题。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask for testing/verification, Claude runs tests and uses multiple AI checkers (functional, security, UX) independently. It consolidates findings, auto-fixes, and gives a QA report with pass/fail and fix summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'qa', 'verify', or ask to run tests. Adding '--quick' switches to quick-fix mode.

say_en.note: Runs Deep mode with 3-way checks and report.
Enters Quick mode; Codex tests and fixes.

say_en.text: Check the src/auth changes for issues.
